_readme: The Boundry product directory. Adding an entry here adds the product to the homepage, Ecosystem, Investors, footer and sitemap on the next build. Only 'id', 'name', 'category', 'summary' and 'responsibility' are required. 'url' may be null when a product has no public site (or its domain does not yet serve one: agentboundry.com did not resolve on 2026-11-01). Product accents live in the design foundation (vendor/stack-ui/brand/brand.json), not here. 'status' must be one of the values in site.json → productStatuses, or null if not yet confirmed for publication. To place a product in the architecture diagram, add its id to site.json → architecture.

products.name: FeltDB
products.summary: A database and application control plane providing durable state and the foundation for applications and agents.

products.name: AppPort
products.summary: A capability catalog and protocol that makes application functionality discoverable and usable by agents, with semantic and authority metadata.

products.name: AppBoundry
products.summary: Technology for application isolation, capability discovery, and portability.

products.name: AuthBoundry
products.summary: Infrastructure for authorization, delegated authority, and controlled access across applications and agents.

products.name: AgentBoundry
products.summary: Infrastructure for building and operating agents with explicit capabilities, boundaries, and execution controls.

products.name: FeltKit
products.summary: An integrated developer platform that brings application development, durable state, capabilities, services, and deployment together.
